goal: Generate a 5-panel cross-style wall sticker anchored by a fictional tall male basketball player in a dunking pose, with consistent purple and gold color cues matching the wooden basketball court floor.

subject.description: A fictional tall male basketball player with strong arms and a headband style, wearing a yellow and purple sleeveless jersey, right arm bent holding the ball at a moment of a layup, recognizable yet cartoon exaggerated treatment.
subject.consistency_rule: The five frames are the same action in frozen frames, with only the medium changing.

layout.format: Center large + small corners, overall deep purple gradient background #1A0A2E fading outward.
layout.label_position: At the bottom edge of each grid
layout.label_design: White text on a deep purple bar.

panels.style: Low saturation sports news photography, shutter freezing droplets of sweat with blurred net ropes
panels.label: PHOTO

panels.style: 90s少年漫画 speed lines and convergence lines
panels.label: ANIME

panels.style: American comic flat color, bold black outline, with dot shading
panels.label: COMIC

panels.style: 16-bit horizontal platform game sprite illustration + pixel score bar
panels.label: PIXEL

panels.style: 3D cartoon, smooth skin with slightly large head-to-body ratio, court lighting bloom
panels.label: 3D TOON

global_constraints.background: Deep purple uniform large bottom, small grids have slight internal shadow separation.

must_keep: Consistent action lines, jersey number area readable but not committing to real team rule details
No addition of large secondary sponsorship logos except for jerseys
avoid: Sudden changes in player body types in the grid.
Political slogans or close-ups of the audience's faces should be recognizable.
Deliberately close to the portrait details of any specific real athlete
